request.prompt_head:
The person asks:
When do I have to object to the 2025 service-charge statement?

response.text:
You have until **Fri 10 Sep 2027** to raise objections to the 2025 service-charge (Betriebs-/Heizkosten) statement from Wohnbau Musterstadt eG [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].

- Ordnung suggests sending it by **Mon 6 Sep 2027** to allow time for the letter to arrive [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- This follows the statutory objection period under § 556 Abs. 3 Satz 5 BGB, counted 12 months from when you received the statement [item:itm_rc1nagh2qjnc].
- You'd notify the landlord in writing of any objections to the figures before this date — you can prepare this via "Draft letter" in Ordnung.

If you disagree with specific cost items, it may be worth getting tenant advice (e.g. Mieterverein) before drafting the objection.
